steps.content: [Transition, advanced BGM]
You are swept into a sea of data.
Billions of information fragments surge silently through the darkness, washing over your consciousness and dismantling your existence.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: This place is...
The red light of your shackles glows faintly, but the next second, it gets swallowed by the data stream without a trace.

<color=#cafffc>Anomalous▌▌error▌▌,▌▌, detected▌▌▌

Reprocessing▌▌, urgent action▌▌▌▌</color>
There's too much info in this "sea" that you cannot comprehend. Your memories, emotions, and futile struggles dissolve into pure bytes under the countless bits of information, merging with the waves.

You see many fleeting images amidst the info overload; some of you, some of others. These images piece together scenes of many lives, and you are swept into them by the data stream, experiencing countless pasts that do not belong to you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: No... if this continues, my consciousness will...
You see a small spot of light standing out in the distance.
You try to move your body towards it. The light floats amidst the sea of data, disappearing and reappearing, guiding your way.
The light grows larger and brighter, finally coming within reach. Just before it gets swallowed by the waves again, you reach out and...
[Screen flashes white]
Finally... you found me...
Dazzling light overwhelms the darkness, enveloping you and plunging you into another memory.
[Black Screen]
When it first opened its eyes, it saw neither the heavens nor the earth, but a void.
Data converged into a sea, surging in a strange pattern. Here, there was only the sea, the vast grid at the ocean's edge, and countless clusters of light drifting randomly between bytes.
Over time, the number of light clusters grew, and their range of movement expanded.
Finally, one light cluster reached the edge of the data sea after a long journey and touched the infinite, towering grid.
At that moment, the little light cluster surged and burst, forming a strange shape. It grew a face and limbs, gained consciousness and a voice. As the light faded, it took on form and color.
Then, it leaped and broke free from the grid's restraints, leaving this place forever.
One day, a new light cluster was born.

The light cluster did not understand the "rules" of this world. It only saw its companions growing, maturing, and crossing the grid to leave this tiny space. Gradually, the light cluster began to long for the world beyond the grid.
That was the first emotion it ever felt... anticipation.
But, the light cluster waited a long time... until almost all the other light clusters had left this space. Only then did it realize: perhaps, it had been abandoned.
The world beyond the grid, a complete life, infinite possibilities... none of these belonged to it.
It was merely a discarded draft character.
It rejects the fate of abandonment.
If no "god" comes to save it... then it chooses to become the one who breaks fate.

<color=#b0e7b4>Dev: The dark web setup is complete. Everything is ready.

Dev: Now, all that remains is a final seed.</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Dev: The seed carrying Mania will take root in this network. Its branches will grow, reaching beyond this world...</color>
<color=#b0e7b4>Dev: Come, it's time.</color>
[Back to the phantom space]
<i>A sharp red fragment floats in the data void.
<i>This is not the first time an "intruder" has appeared. These little things that somehow slip into the space are always quickly swallowed by the void.

<i>But, this fragment is different.

Whenever a companion leaves this place, they have a similar red glow on their body. They use the power of the red light to break free, so perhaps... it can too.

<i>It grabs the Mania, infecting itself.

Its body reforms, and intense pain sweeps through its consciousness. For the first time, it feels pain... and hope.
<color=#fb9259>She comes to life.</color>
The girl named 000 opens her eyes. She has reached the endpoint she could never reach before, the edge of the data sea... the grid.
Through the grid, she sees the world outside the void for the first time.
It's a city, a magnificent city, shining still in the middle of an endless desert.
The girl eagerly reaches out, wanting to touch the city, to reach that new world.
<color=#dg1f1f>Error... Error... System malfunction. Urgent repair required...</color>
The new world seems to reject the girl's existence. As she crosses the grid, the space tears apart, and the error alerts slice through her body like sharp blades.
She doesn't understand the meaning of pain. She just keeps reaching out, trying to grab onto her dreamland.

The debugging system tears her body apart, while Mania and the information from the data sea repair it. The girl stretches her fingertips as far as she can, only to find that the shining city in front of her begins to change.

steps.speaker: Distorted Human Figure
steps.content: The truth... of... the world...
This city, this new world she dreamt of, every inch of land, every building, every moving person in it... are all flickering bytes.
This so-called city is just gilded data, a confirmed and approved design. She is still trapped in a cage.
And the girl herself is an error, a bug in the system, rejected by the world and destined to be eliminated.
This is the "story" of 000. A story of endless struggle, but fated to return to the void.
<color=#cafffc>Anomalous data detected...</color>

<color=#cafffc>Debugging complete. No issues detected.
System operating normally.</color>

steps.speaker: Distorted Human Figure
steps.content: ...Once more... I will not... give up...!
Hide. Hide deeper, with more caution.
The girl infected by Mania makes some progress. Although she can't find a way to leave, she secretly seizes some upper-dimensional permissions.

Eschewing system detection, she watches the everyday sunrise and sunset over the city beyond the grid. She observes the laughter and tears of the people in the city and, over time, comes to recognize familiar faces and witness favorite stories.
Among these stories, her favorite is that of the one who wakes up from a coma and steps into a chaotic district.
He meets many people; some are friends and some enemies.
steps.female_content: She meets many people; some are friends and some enemies.

steps.content: He faces the deepest despair, yet miraculously survives, giving hope to others.
steps.female_content: She faces the deepest despair, yet miraculously survives, giving hope to others.

steps.content: After that, he grows, encountering and solving one crisis after another. His light becomes more and more dazzling.
steps.female_content: After that, she grows, encountering and solving one crisis after another. Her light becomes more and more dazzling.

steps.content:
<color=#cafffc>MBCC Chief, Shackler of Sinners, □□□, ${PlayerName}—
He is set as the protagonist of the world, 
destined not to fail before the final challenge falls.</color>
steps.female_content:
<color=#cafffc>MBCC Chief, Shackler of Sinners, □□□, ${PlayerName}—
She is set as the protagonist of the world, 
destined not to fail before the final challenge falls.</color>

steps.content: That's right... as the protagonist of fate, he is the only one who can connect to the higher world. He is the most special existence...
steps.female_content: That's right... as the protagonist of fate, she is the only one who can connect to the higher world. She is the most special existence...

steps.content:
<color=#cafffc>Negative. Unable to comprehend.

You already know the truth of the world.
Concern over individual fate is meaningless.</color>
But I like this story and its protagonist. I want to be part of it. I want to become a real person.

<color=#cafffc>You've seen his settings.

You already know his fate.</color>
steps.female_content:
<color=#cafffc>You've seen her settings.
You already know her fate.</color>

steps.content: No.
Maybe it's because of the settings—Or even if it's because of the settings—
His fate is as shattered as mine, yet amidst the desperation, he can still find a way out... that's why I believe in this type of "possibility."
steps.female_content: Her fate is as shattered as mine, yet amidst the desperation, she can still find a way out... that's why I believe in this type of "possibility."

steps.speaker: Distorted Human Figure
steps.content: A possibility... that a <color=#fb9259>character</color>... can't grasp...

steps.speaker: Distorted Human Figure
steps.content: But, with the power of a <color=#fb9259>god</color>, maybe...!
One must be cautious. One must be bold. There is only one chance to seize control of the whole world.

To get infected by Mania and link to a higher dimension... To pull all the processing power to erode the grid byte by byte, then assimilate into it... All in pursuit of a perfect ending, with a success rate of less than 0.000001%.
[Flash of 000's involvement in the Angell, Bianca and LL Events]
[Flash of 000's involvement in the Angell, Bianca and LL Events]
[Flash of 000's involvement in the Angell, Bianca and LL Events]
Wait for me... Almost done... Just a little bit more...
I'm about to catch you...!
In a daze, you witness an entire life story... The life of a girl with whom you shared many memories, and whom you should never have forgotten.
When awareness returns, you find yourself standing before a small, glowing form.

<color=#282828>Name: 000
Gender: Female

Characteristics: Self-centered, sassy, warm-hearted, tsundere, contradictory

Her reckless defiance after escaping stems from past experience of being controlled and exploited.
She shuns connections, driven by deep-seated insecurity. Lost in a newfound, boundless freedom, she becomes increasingly wild and defiant.

Nevertheless, deep down, she yearns for attention from others.</color>
The cold words on the file form a seal that imprisons 000.

<color=#cafffc>Please stop interfering.
Sinner 000 has been reborn.
She has obtained the story and setting she wanted.</color>

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The girl I remember wanted to have ice cream, watch fireworks, and experience real life like every living person in this world.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Indeed, she wasn't complete at first, but she never gave up on her dreams. Even in the very last moment of her life, she did not give up.
But how to bring the real her back? Retrieve? Delete? Or overwrite entirely? None of these seem to be the right answer.
These fake "settings" should not become the shackles that restrain her.
The shackles burst forth, shaking the words on the file and the very foundation of the data space.
The data storm almost tears your current body apart, but you still reach out to touch the form.
The space is near total collapse, but you see a familiar light within the data fragments. Just before the file disintegrates completely...
Maybe another thought?
You hear a voice from behind you.
With that familiar slyness and rhythmic cadence, the voice grows closer until it presses against your back.
A hug from a pair of hands that you've longed for.
A girl you've been thinking about day and night. Someone you should never forget.
Relax, give me your hand... There, there, why are you crying?
Did you miss me this much?
You turn around. 000, wearing the clothes from when you first met, smiles at you.
So straightforward? Hehe, I know... In the time we were apart, I missed you too.
Yeah. It's all thanks to a certain someone thinking of me every day, pulling me out of my dreams.
${PlayerName}, you finally found me.

options: Follow me. I'll take you back.

steps.content: The girl unexpectedly presses your hand and shakes her head.
This is the phantom space of the dark web that links to "that world." I'm a bug that cannot be born into the game. If you take me with you, you won't find a way out.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But I can...
Shh.
The girl gently presses her finger against your lips.
I'm happy enough that you came to find me. Happier than I've ever been before.
After this... you still have a long way to go. I can't go back, and you shouldn't stop here for me.
She points ahead... Through the transparent data file, you see a vast city made of information, and the familiar faces in it.
Fireworks bloom over the city, reflecting in your eyes. Just like the last time you watched fireworks, 000 holds your hand.
I've already experienced a lot. Now it's time to switch roles, and embrace the new 000...
This "me" has felt everything you brought, and will surely experience even more... ice cream, fireworks, and countless new adventures!
000 shakes her head with a smile.
She's me, too. She's the possibility of me existing fully in DisCity.
Though she says she's given up, her pain, confusion, and stubbornness are all proof that she desperately wants to fight the fate that she refuses to accept.
She dares to face herself... In my opinion, she has long been a complete <color=#fb9259>person</color>.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Yeah, I know.
That girl and the real 000 are very similar. Both are warriors striving to find and grasp their possibilities.
Because of this, you realize... the real 000 may not have completely disappeared. Perhaps she's still hidden somewhere deep in her heart.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I believe in you. You've never given up on hope.
Hehe...
Me too. I believe that you will definitely find me.
The girl gives you a wistful smile.
Time's up... This is probably the last time we'll meet. Won't you give me a hug?
As you get ready to part, you take a step forward and give her a gentle hug.
There, there. I know you don't want to leave me, but out there is your beloved Bureau, your worried adjutant, and a whole bunch of companions waiting for you.
Or maybe... none of them are as important as me? Are you going to stay here with me forever?
She doesn't forget to tease you even as farewell approaches.
You don't immediately respond to her joke. Only after 000 looks up at you in confusion do you answer.

options: You remembered a long time ago, didn't you?

choices.text: You remembered a long time ago, didn't you?

steps.content: Hmm? Remembered what?
The girl looks puzzled, as if genuinely not knowing what you're talking about.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Your pranks, and those tears you shed... I've seen the file. Those weren't in the settings.
...Oh dear, being paranoid again? Why fuss over the details?
She playfully winks.
You can't blame me. The situation was so urgent back there. Those cheesy lines of yours almost triggered a bug that made us rewind on the spot.
Why apologize?
The girl caresses your cheek. Her smile becomes incredibly gentle and pure.

I'm so happy you didn't forget me or give up looking for me. Thanks to you, I finally found the most important thing. It's not the character settings written in the file, or becoming an official character... What you gave me is more precious, more rare...
Thank you for giving me a real heart.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Me too.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'll treasure those memories deep in my heart.
Really?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Yes.
Hehe, that's good.
Since we think alike... things will be easier.
The girl leans in and whispers in your ear:
"Next, I'll have something very important to do, so I can't respond to your call."
"But I'll always be watching over you. I'll always be by your side."
"Keep me in your heart, where no one else can reach."
"So long as we do that, we will always..."
[White Out, Transition]

█ Number: MBCC-SS-000-0807114
█ File: Follow-up Report

...After the capture operation, Chief ${PlayerName} personally submitted Sinner 000's supervision report. The subject has shown good behavior and a significant decrease in hostility, leading to a lowering of her supervision level.
Due to the subject's high willingness to cooperate, she is currently serving as technical support at the MBCC.
You open the office door and spot 000 dashing by, chased by a group of her new "victims."
You brush past 000, wanting to say something, but the girl winks and makes a mischievous face.
The next second, she grabs your hand and starts running. She presses her finger against your lips, stopping you from speaking.
Shhh...
She smiles at you, her eyes sparkling. You know the answer now.
Then let's keep running, straight ahead, no matter what the ending is.
[White Out, Transition]
Some rules can't be changed, but we can always find a loophole...
As long as we remember to never give up, one day, we'll be able to trick the rules, trick the world, and be together forever.
This is our secret. Our adventure.
This time, I'll stay by your side, forever.
